reason: I like the idea of blowing people's minds at a birthday, but an app that's not in the App Store or Google Play, where I type my card into some website I've never heard of? No way. I'd play with the free tricks and stop there.
objection: Paying 99 shekels by card on an unknown website for an app installed from the browser feels like a scam risk, and I'm not sure my friends won't see it's fake.
would_change_my_mind: If it were sold through the App Store or Google Play, so I pay the way I always do and can get a refund if it doesn't work.
